name: Rubik's Cube OGU Open 2006
information: Competition from 10am until 5pm. Participation and visiting are free. Nearest stations: JR Ibaraki-Station and Hankyu Ibarakishi-Station. Only preregistered competitors can participate. Limits: 3x3x3 120 seconds 30 competitors, Pyraminx 60 seconds 10 competitors, Square-1 4 minutes 5 competitors. Only licensed puzzles are permitted.
